bug_semantics: The n8n Git node runs git via simple-git against a caller-chosen repository path. Git then honors repository-local .git/config keys whose values are external programs (core.fsmonitor, core.sshCommand, core.pager, diff.external, credential.helper, core.gitProxy, gpg.program, init.templateDir, and historically core.hooksPath). Those values were not overridden or neutralized, so any later Git-node operation against a repo containing a planted command-bearing key executed that command as the n8n process user. The node's own addConfig UI/API was later restricted to user.email/user.name/remote.origin.url and is not the exploit path; planting required a separate file-write.
flaw_origin: The un-neutralized simple-git invocation was first written in reconstructable PR member f81e76aca958dab7392942e8a74b7919e7db42b5 (':sparkles: Add Git-Node', 2021-03-13): Git.node.ts constructed simpleGit({baseDir}) with no git -c pin of command-bearing keys. Immediate parent 06dd4236482d345b1193b87b993c944b117698bd has no packages/nodes-base/nodes/Git/Git.node.ts. GitHub squash-merge 3667b0dd01f82046549b795b98b88983bd7c7fbb ('Add Git node (#1820)') re-landed the same mechanism on master and is the squash aggregate, not the first-write. Later 4dd853b2d5 only pinned core.hooksPath; 8382e27c5a/5102991310 only restricted addConfig keys. First-party GHSA-m87g-qr43-ccvc names leftover local-config execution and the 1.123.69 / 2.33.4 / 2.34.1 patched boundary.

reasoning: The vulnerability is git honoring command-bearing keys from a repo-local config while the Git node runs operations, not the later addConfig allowlist and not hooks-only pinning. f81e76ac is the smallest public first-write of that un-neutralized simple-git(baseDir) path; its parent tree lacks Git.node.ts. 3667b0dd is a GitHub squash-merge of PR #1820 and is excluded as BIC; the git-node branch members are reconstructable and f81 is the first of them. 4dd853b2d5 (core.hooksPath=/dev/null) and 8382e27c5a (ALLOWED_CONFIG_KEYS) are incomplete relative to GHSA-m87g, matching the advisory statement that Git-node config controls already blocked direct key setting. The published patched tags first contain COMMAND_CONFIG_KEYS -c overrides at 1.123.69 / 2.33.4 / 2.34.1, matching CVE.org rather than the advisory's 1.123.67/2.31.5/2.32.1 prose. 3e4fb19caf is the 1.x public landing of that pin (single-parent bundle; private pre-bundle members not reconstructable). CVE.org remains PUBLISHED, so not FALSE_POSITIVE. AI judgment is BIC-only: f81 is human Jan Oberhauser with no commit-object AI marker. Bot authorship on the 2026 bundle fix does not attribute introduction.
